The reviewer independently ran all 17 focused tests successfully, including altered exported text, altered readable text, omitted table qualifications, and changed or removed mapping evidence.

plan_clause: Section 4: For each example, link requirement groups and state whether the document presents the example as satisfying or violating particular requirements; explicitly record unspecified status.
problem: A blanket whole-example unspecified status displaced the required per-requirement presentation judgments.
evidence: Initial NET-002 compliance.status was unspecified because no complete configured instance was proved. Its three requirement_links repeated only that the example depicts a requirement subject. The source explicitly uses Figure 2 to show required Outer Firewall placement and physical separation. NET-006 and NET-010 likewise had only generic relation text despite clause-specific source illustrations. The historical review nevertheless claimed no material extraction defects.
proposed_correction: Preserve whole-instance compliance as unknown while recording each illustrated requirement clause with exact source and group references, a scoped source-presentation status, justification, requirement strength, conditions, and limits. Independently review the new mappings; retain prior review files as historical evidence.
resolution: Independently reviewed all 92 clause-scoped mappings for 27 examples against the original document text and all ten crop images. The mappings cover 33 groups, including eight prose-only groups, with 40 presented-as-satisfying, 41 required-but-not-demonstrated, eight ambiguous, and three not-applicable judgments. No source-presented violation was found. Exact quotations, clause membership, conditions, strength, and qualifications were checked. The final NET-010 evidence addition was reviewed. The requirement-view header now distinguishes selected-clause illustration from whole-solution implementation compliance.

proposed_correction: Remove the physical-medium claim from that branch of unknowns and retain only unknown port identities and address values. Keep the LAN/VLAN alternative separate.
resolution: Verified NET-017 direct_physical_connection now limits unknowns to serial port identity and configuration parameters. The serial cable remains the source-stated physical connection, and the network-placement alternative keeps its own unknowns.

plan_clause: Sections 4 and 5: Distinguish source-stated facts from interpretations and device roles from named instances.

evidence: NET-021 cites only prose about routing protocols on Red/Black networks, which names no Router device. NET-022 cites independent IPv4/IPv6 selection, which names no Solution Component device. Generic no-deployed-instance notes do not make those categories explicit source facts.

resolution: Verified NET-021 and NET-022 have no fabricated device placeholders. Their network/protocol records remain, and the role-instance projection removes NET-021-router and NET-022-solution-component.

plan_clause: Section 6: Separate reviewed representation, unresolved material interpretation, later network-model justification, and theorem proof.
problem: Ordinary evidence limits and domain-review scope were mixed into the count of open source interpretations.
evidence: REQ-I14 says only that source illustrations do not establish complete compliance, implementation tests, or theorem proofs. That evidence boundary is required by the plan and needs no source resolution. REQ-I13 concerns legal-domain interpretation of RG-076, rather than ambiguous technical source wording for all targets. REQ-I06 and REQ-I07 also described compatible cumulative restrictions as blocking source interpretations: separate function VMs do not authorize sharing an AW host; a minimum ACL condition does not waive physical and cryptographic separation.
proposed_correction: Move REQ-I14 to acknowledged, nonblocking evidence-scope metadata. Classify REQ-I13 as domain-review scope limited to RG-076. Report source questions, external dependencies, domain scope, and ordinary evidence limitations separately; keep global readiness false where material questions remain. Resolve I06 and I07 by preserving all cumulative constraints and recording the interpretation, without inventing a weaker exception.
resolution: Verified REQ-I06 and REQ-I07 moved to resolved_interpretations with cumulative constraints retained in RG-045 and RG-044. REQ-I13 moved to domain_review_scope and blocks only RG-076. REQ-I14 moved to acknowledged, nonblocking evidence_scope_notes. The open source register now contains 11 issues rather than 15; no global readiness approval follows from that reclassification.
